findings.message: padding with four values sets right and left by name of position. It does not mirror in right-to-left.

fix.description: Write the two axes: padding-block: var(--syntara-space-6) var(--syntara-space-8); padding-inline: var(--syntara-space-5) var(--syntara-space-4). The values change order, so check it.
fix.replacement: padding-block: var(--syntara-space-6) var(--syntara-space-8); padding-inline: var(--syntara-space-5) var(--syntara-space-4)
